isolation_controls: Clearinghouse ePHI resides in a dedicated AWS account with no trust relationship to the parent organization
Network segmentation and separate VPCs prevent lateral access from corporate systems
Distinct IAM identity store and access-review process scoped to clearinghouse staff only
Encryption keys are managed in a clearinghouse-only KMS with separate administrators
justification: Acme operates a health care clearinghouse as a business unit within the larger organization; the controls above isolate its ePHI from the rest of the company.
